subject.title: BL-shipping-carrier-03: migrate shipMatrix pattern notation to standard regex

question: How should the regex migration handle inactive rows and existing `X` semantics while preserving current matching?
rationale: The issue direction is confirmed, but the triage comment identifies data semantics that require owner/operator choice before a safe Mongo plus code migration.

options.title: Preserve all current semantics except the known malformed row
options.body: Convert all 25 rows to equivalent standard regex, keep inactive rows represented, and explicitly fix or retire `AMAZON PROMO NAVIDAD` as part of the migration.

options.title: Migrate only active rows first
options.body: Convert the 21 active rows and leave inactive rows unchanged or retired, reducing runtime risk but leaving historical matrix cleanup unresolved.

options.title: Pause until live data policy is settled
options.body: Keep code unchanged until the owner decides whether disabled rows should remain migration targets.

recommendation.title: Preserve all current semantics except the known malformed row
recommendation.body: Convert all 25 rows to equivalent standard regex, keep inactive rows represented, and explicitly fix or retire `AMAZON PROMO NAVIDAD` as part of the migration.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn authored the recent BL carrier work and reported this owner-approved follow-up with the concrete acceptance criteria.
